name: Etching of the Dextrous shares the Agility class-buff category (COA-6091)
contract: Class buffs that grant the same statistic form one exclusive group (2110001 for Agility): the newest replaces the previous one. The Runemaster's Etching of the Dextrous 561237 joins it, so it replaces the Templar's Inquisitor's Edict 706741 instead of stacking with it, while a Runemaster's own Etchings keep their class rules.
